verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a pre-built "ML in a Box" template that comes preinstalled with the major ML frameworks and CUDA drivers, which covers the PyTorch/CUDA part of the story. The machine-creation flow lets you pick an OS or a template. The custom templates feature only snapshots your own configured machines; it is not a library of pre-built templates. Missing for 10: any evidence of vLLM or ComfyUI templates, a documented catalog listing which frameworks and versions are included, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the templates work out of the box.
